ask.title: Ask about Jan
ask.subtitle: An AI assistant that answers questions about my experience, skills and projects from my own documents. Ask anything a recruiter or a client would ask.
ask.note: Answers are generated by AI from Jan's CV and project notes.

steps.title: My documents
steps.desc: CV, project notes and short write-ups, kept as plain text.

steps.title: Embeddings
steps.desc: Each paragraph is turned into a numeric fingerprint of its meaning.

steps.title: Vector search
steps.desc: Your question is matched against those fingerprints to find the relevant paragraphs.

steps.title: LLM
steps.desc: A language model (Claude) writes the answer only from what was found.

steps.title: Answer with sources
steps.desc: You get the answer plus chips showing which documents it came from.

chat.title: Jan's AI assistant
chat.subtitle: Answers from Jan's CV and project notes
chat.welcome: Hi, I am Jan's AI assistant. Ask me about his experience, skills or projects and I will answer from his own documents.
chips: What AI tools does Jan use?
Tell me about his SaaS project
Is he a fit for a remote AI engineer role?
What did he do at MSD?
chat.fallback: I don't know that from Jan's documents, so I would rather not guess. Please contact Jan directly, he will be happy to answer.
chat.errorBody: The answer could not be generated. Please try again in a moment.
chat.invalidTitle: I could not read that question.
chat.invalidBody: Please write it as a sentence, up to 500 characters.
chat.limitTitle: You have reached the limit of {limit} questions per hour.
chat.limitBody: Please try again in about {minutes} minutes, or contact Jan directly.
chat.dailyTitle: The assistant has answered all the questions it can for today.
chat.dailyBody: Please try again tomorrow, or contact Jan directly.
chat.label: Your question about Jan
chat.placeholder: Ask about Jan's experience, skills or projects
chat.hint: Press Enter to send. The CV is the source of truth.
chat.inactiveBody: It will be switched on in a few days. Until then, download the CV or write to Jan directly.
